## Featured Shipped Projects & Case Studies

### 1. Sanctum House of Wellness
- **Category**: Web (Desktop + Mobile) · Fitness & Wellness
- **Role**: UI/UX Designer @ The Social Slate (2025)
- **Core Challenge**: Bridge the gap between luxury wellness branding and real-world physical footfall across 3 Mumbai clubs (Andheri, Khar, Juhu) without cognitive overload.
- **Solution & Design Interventions**:
  - Engineered a balanced two-pillar homepage structure (*Training + Recovery*).
  - Placed immediate geographic club discovery right after the core value proposition.
  - Deployed intent-focused conversion actions (WhatsApp chat, one-tap phone calls, GPS directions) on club landing pages.
- **Key Metrics & Outcomes**:
  - **~3× increase in direct club enquiries** during active Meta advertising campaigns.
  - Eliminated high drop-off rates on mobile paid traffic.
  - United 3 physical flagship clubs under a coherent, frictionless web architecture.

### 2. RIZEN — Gamified Habit Formation App
- **Category**: Mobile App (iOS / Android) · HealthTech & Habit Formation
- **Role**: Product Designer (2025)
- **Core Challenge**: 78% of fitness app users abandon their routine entirely after breaking a streak due to guilt and friction. The challenge was: *"The problem isn't starting; it's restarting."*
- **Solution & Design Interventions**:
  - "Designing for the comeback, not the streak": low-friction 15-minute reactivation flows.
  - Separated calm workout planning from high-focus live workout execution mode.
  - Replaced toxic global leaderboards with intimate friend accountability pods.
  - Architected a 6-tier XP rank progression ladder (Iron to Rizen Elite) that rewards consistency over perfection.
- **Key Metrics & Outcomes**:
  - 37 quantitative research surveys & 5 deep qualitative interviews.
  - Delivered comprehensive end-to-end mobile design system and interactive prototype.

### 3. Quantel AI — Wealth Management Platform
- **Category**: FinTech · Web App & Mobile App · Wealth Management & AI
- **Role**: UI/UX Designer (2025)
- **Core Challenge**: Extend an existing enterprise AI investment platform into new production-ready modules while strictly maintaining 100% design system consistency.
- **Solution & Design Interventions**:
  - Structured multi-tiered asset data from broad portfolio health down to granular holdings.
  - Designed progressive step-by-step onboarding for *Quantel Capital* and *Quantel Advise* to prevent cognitive fatigue in high-stakes financial decisions.
  - Expanded the tokenized design system to support a high-contrast Light Mode and a gamified Points & Rewards engagement loop.
- **Key Metrics & Outcomes**:
  - 5+ new core production-ready product flows delivered.
  - 100% adherence to established FinTech design tokens and component guidelines.
  - Unified multi-platform experience across responsive web and mobile viewports.

### 4. Side Quests — Micro-UX Friction Experiments
- **Category**: Product Design Explorations · Mobile & Web
- **Explorations**:
  - **Instagram Reels**: Solved DM context switching by allowing continuous in-feed browsing of reels shared by friends.
  - **Flipkart Checkout**: Added high-visibility contextual order review cards directly on the payment screen to boost buyer trust and reduce cart abandonment.
  - **Nothing Calculator**: Minimalist, tactile calculator interface aligning with Nothing OS typography and spatial design language.

### 5. Strength App UX Usability Research
- **Category**: UX Research & Competitive Benchmarking
- **Audited**: Strong, JEFIT, and Hevy platforms with 15 active strength athletes.
- **Outcome**: Identified the "Tedium Barrier" in workout logging; engineered the conceptual "Three-Tap Log" framework to eliminate friction during physical training.
